title: Payload container
text: Within a PLMN, this IE shall be included if the UE has one or more stored UE policy sections identified by a UPSI with the PLMN ID part indicating the HPLMN or the selected PLMN for the registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update due to inter-system change from S1 mode to N1 mode of a UE operating in the single-registration mode or for the registration procedure for initial registration
Within an SNPN, this IE shall be included if the UE has one or more stored UE policy sections for the selected SNPN for the registration procedure for initial registration
